blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – After testifying on his financial review of Vice President Sara Duterte, and her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio’s wealth on Friday, financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexandra B. Cabrera stated that paying one’s taxes shows integrity. Cabrera, the expert witness of the House prosecution panel, made the statement after he presented his analysis of Duterte’s statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALN); bank records, and income tax returns; financial statements from their business interests, and the reports of the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC).
